name: @attest/sandbox-scripts
description: Standalone dependency manifest so the audit sandbox installs ONLY what these three scripts need (better-sqlite3 + tsx) instead of the entire Attest monorepo, which OOM-killed the sandbox. Deliberately NOT a declared workspace of the root package.json, so `cd sandbox-scripts && npm install` resolves just this tree. Locally these scripts still resolve better-sqlite3/tsx from the repo root via normal upward node_modules lookup, so nothing changes for development.
